usereventscript.name: SUST - Item Receipt Buttons
usereventscript.description: Adds Enter Lot Quality and Process Material buttons to Item Receipts for Sustana Recovery (subsidiary ID configurable via script parameter)

scriptcustomfield.description: Internal ID of the Sustana Recovery subsidiary in this NetSuite account. Set this on the deployment to enable the IR buttons. Set to the same value as custscript_sust_subsidiary_id on the settlement script.
scriptcustomfield.help: Required. Set to the Sustana Recovery subsidiary's internal ID (e.g., 7 in the demo account). If unset, the script logs an error and skips processing.
scriptcustomfield.label: Sustana Recovery Subsidiary ID
